Nearshore AI software development
# Software development from Argentina, powered by AI agents.

You want software shipped, without paying US agency rates. Totono is a nearshore AI software factory: engineers in Argentina run a fleet of AI coding agents on your codebase. You get the output of a team at a fraction of the cost.

## Why nearshore

- Same workday: our engineers work on US Eastern Time.
- Lower cost: Argentina costs less than a US-based team.
- US contract: you sign with TOTONO LLC, a Delaware company. One invoice, one point of contact.
- English and Spanish.

## Why AI agents

Agents write most of the code. Our engineers plan the work, run the agents and review every change. One engineer with a fleet of agents ships what usually takes a team. We work with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok, or the agent you already use.

## How it compares

- Traditional outsourcing agency: you pay for headcount. With Totono, you pay for an engineer whose agents do the work of several.
- Hiring in-house: months to recruit. We connect to your repo, CI, tracker and deploys, and start shipping in days.
- Using AI agents yourself: someone still has to run them and check their work. Our engineers do that, and the [control plane](https://totono.xyz/#control-plane) keeps your team in charge of what agents can touch.

## What is a nearshore AI software factory?

A software development team in a nearby time zone that ships with AI coding agents. At Totono, engineers in Argentina run a fleet of agents on your codebase and review every change.

## Is it cheaper than a US agency or in-house team?

Yes. Argentina costs less than a US-based team, and agents do much of the work, so one engineer covers what usually takes several. You get a written price before any work starts.

## Is cheaper also riskier?

No. Your developers decide what agents may touch, critical changes wait for a human, and every pull request is reviewed by an engineer.

## Do I contract with a foreign company?

No. You contract with TOTONO LLC, a Delaware company. One invoice, one point of contact.

## Get a price

The first call is free. Then you get a written proposal with scope, timeline and price. [Get in touch](https://totono.xyz/contact), or read the [FAQ](https://totono.xyz/faq).
